# tools/ index

**Generated by `node tools/m59-index.mjs`. Do not edit by hand.**

287 tools, 224 tests. 1 tool(s) have no header comment.

Read this before writing a new tool. `node tools/m59-index.mjs --find <word>`
searches it. If what you need is here, use it; if it is nearly here, extend it.

| `webui` | THE FIELD COMMAND PAGE, STARTED AND STOPPED WITH THE BROKER. |
| `wedges` | EVERY PLACE IN THE WORLD A CHARACTER CAN GET STUCK, WRITTEN DOWN. |
| `which` | WHICH FLEET AM I ABOUT TO ACT ON, AND IS IT THE ONE THAT IS RUNNING? |
| `world` | The agent's world model: everything known about where it is standing, assembled |
| `worldstate` | THE CLOSED VOCABULARY A PLAN IS WRITTEN IN. |
| `zap` | the zap enchantment state machine for the tick driver. |
| `m59` | Bridge between Meridian 59 and this conversation. Zero dependencies. |
| `setup` | BRING UP EVERYTHING, FROM A BARE CLONE. Zero dependencies, Windows and Linux. |
